title: Rainyday
description:
Список возможностей• A unique and dark, linear story-driven adventure.

• Challenging puzzles.

• Four separate short episodes, each about 20 minutes long and with distinct cases about dark world of human trafficking in the city of New Orleans.

• It always rains.

Об игреRainyday is a gritty and atmospheric, top-down, old school detective adventure about human trafficking inspired by Sierra's classics and 1990s masterpieces like Dreamweb, Harvester, Bloodnet etc.

Take the role of John Rainy. An ageing, tired and depressed NOPD detective investigating strange child disappearances in the city of New Orleans. 

Jump in and descent into the dark, grim world of Rainyday, where superstitious beliefs prevail and the evil of man knows no limits.

Purchasing this product will grant access to ALL four episodes.
